Lina C (Content): Heads-up: were consolidating launch assets for the May webinar + benchmark post. Need a prioritized list and quick turnaround. Main asks: one hero for the blog, three social creatives (static + 1x animated GIF), webinar slide hero, gated slide-deck cover, and a compact "cheat sheet" PNG for sales. Who can pick this up? :wave:

Marta (DesignOps): Hi! Sounds doable. Can you confirm sizes and whether the GIF needs to be captioned/looped? Also any localization or headliner variants for testing?

Lina C (Content): Sizes: blog hero 1400x800, social 1200x1200 (IG), 1080x1920 (stories), 1200x628 (linkedin). GIF should be 800x800, loop 3s, lightweight (<300kb) with subtle sparkline animation for the three metrics (latency/cost/throughput). Two headline variants for A/B: "Benchmarked: inference economics that scale" and "Spend less per token, ship faster". No localization for launch — EN only.

Jackson (PMM): Add: slide-deck cover (1920x1080) + a 1-page cheat sheet (single-column PNG 800x2000) for SDRs. The cheat sheet should include short bullets and a tiny vector diagram showing serving modes. Make the diagram editable in Figma.

Faizan (Paid Ads): Also want a 600x314 ad creative and a 300x250 retargeting tile. For the GIF variant well test on FB/IG feed; please supply MP4 fallback (looping) and a static first-frame PNG. Provide filename suffixes for channel targeting.

Marta (DesignOps): Noted. Brand constraints? Which logo lockups, colors, and legal footers to use?

Lina C (Content): Use the 2026 brand kit here: https://drive.redwood/brand/2026-spring. Mandatory: stacked lockup for social, horizontal for blog/webinar. Include small compliance line on gated assets: "Benchmark tests reflect representative production workloads; model: gpt-neox-XX." Legal approved.

Marta (DesignOps): ETA proposal: initial blog hero + one social static + GIF prototype in 48 hours, full set in 5 business days. Deliverables: PNG/SVG for vectors, GIF + MP4 for animation, Figma file with component variants, and an export README with alt text and suggested CTAs.

Lina C (Content): Can we also get alt copy suggestions per asset? e.g., for social tile headline + 2 caption variants and CTA text for ad vs organic (Register / Learn more).

Jackson (PMM): For the gated deck cover, include a small lock icon and the CTA: "Download benchmark + playbook". Also request an editable slide master so sales can drop in slide content.

Faizan (Paid Ads): Tagging on UTMs: include a README that lists canonical campaign parameters: utm_source=web, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=bench_may2026. Will need filenames that map to channels: `blog_1400x800_v1.png`, `social_1200x1200_A.png`, `social_1200x1200_B.gif`, `gif_800x800_mp4.mp4`, `ad_600x314.png`, `cheatsheet_sdr_800x2000.png`.
